title: Firewall/Interfaces/Containers robustness relook pass
acceptance_criteria: Containers first-run setup supports configurable default network creation in the bootstrap flow.
Container bootstrap endpoint accepts setup payload without breaking existing API callers.
Firewall zones create/edit workflows support interface selection from discovered interfaces with description-first labels.
Interface cards show description-first display while preserving canonical interface identifiers.
Backend tests cover bootstrap network setup path and frontend validation gates pass.
assumptions: Bootstrap setup should keep SSH automation enabled by default while allowing optional default-network creation.
Discovered interface checkbox selection plus manual override input is sufficient for advanced zone interface naming.
Existing unrelated working-tree changes remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Extended /vyos/containers/bootstrap to accept setup payload and added pytest coverage for network-only bootstrap mode.
Implemented bootstrap setup form fields, wired payload submission, added zone interface selectors, and made interface cards description-first.
Executed backend pytest plus frontend typecheck/lint/build/runtime smoke/browser smoke.
Manual reviewer checklist completed; reviewer-agent dispatch was blocked by thread cap.
